meta.title: Practice Hashiwokakero · unlimited free puzzles · Hashi
meta.description: Practice Hashiwokakero (Bridges) without the clock: unlimited puzzles in five sizes from 7×7 to 24×24, hints and checks, each with exactly one solution.

heading: the bridges puzzle
generating_text: Growing islands, building bridges, and asking the SAT solver whether the solution is unique…

card.title: Practice
card.text: As many fresh puzzles as you like, each proven by the SAT solver to have exactly one solution. No clock pressure, the daily bridge is on the home page.

legend.title: How to build
legend.build: Click the water between two islands, or drag from an island.
legend.again: Click again for a second bridge, a third click removes them.
legend.remove: Right click or <kbd>Shift</kbd> + click removes a bridge.
